Class ImagePreviewPopup

  • java.lang.Object
    • gui.ImagePreviewPopup

  • public class ImagePreviewPopup
extends java.lang.Object
    A lightweight, frameless floating JavaFX popup window that displays dynamic image previews when hovering over media records.

    Includes an LRU memory cache to serve previously decoded thumbnails quickly, avoiding unnecessary re-decodes on repeated hovers.

    Since:
    7 September 2026
    Version:
    1.2
    Author:
    Trevor Maggs

    • Method Detail

      • clearCache

        public void clearCache()
        Clears all cached thumbnails from memory. Call this if the active workspace or target directory changes.

      • dispose

        public void dispose()
        Cancels pending operations, hides the stage, and shuts down the background image loader. Call this when shutting down the application.

      • hide

        public void hide()
        Hides the preview popup stage and releases the displayed image reference. The image remains cached in memory within thumbnailCache.

      • showPreview

        public void showPreview(FileProcessingRecord record,
                        double screenX,
                        double screenY)
        Displays the preview thumbnail overlay for a specified file record at the given cursor coordinates.

        Checks the LRU memory cache before reading from disk. On a cache miss, JPG and PNG images are decoded using native JavaFX image pipelines, while other formats are decoded using an ImageIO ImageReader configured with source subsampling via TwelveMonkeys.

        Parameters:
        record - the FileProcessingRecord containing target path and magic signature metadata
        screenX - the absolute horizontal cursor coordinate on screen
        screenY - the absolute vertical cursor coordinate on screen

      • showThumbnailPopup

        private void showThumbnailPopup(double screenX,
                                double screenY)
        Displays the thumbnail preview popup and positions it relative to the specified screen coordinates.

        The popup is positioned to the lower-right of the cursor when space permits. If insufficient space is available at the right or bottom edge of the screen, the popup is repositioned to the opposite side of the cursor.

        Parameters:
        screenX - the absolute horizontal cursor coordinate on screen
        screenY - the absolute vertical cursor coordinate on screen

      • readThumbnail

        private javafx.scene.image.Image readThumbnail(java.nio.file.Path path,
                                               int targetWidth,
                                               int targetHeight)
        Reads and scales an image to create a lightweight thumbnail using a native ImageIO image reader.

        Source sub-sampling is used to reduce the amount of image data decoded for large source images.

        Parameters:
        path - the Path to the target image file
        targetWidth - the maximum desired thumbnail width in pixels
        targetHeight - the maximum desired thumbnail height in pixels
        Returns:
        a scaled JavaFX Image, or null if decoding fails or no reader is registered

      • isViewable

        private boolean isViewable(DigitalSignature type)
        Determines whether a digital signature corresponds to a supported preview format.
        Parameters:
        type - the DigitalSignature magic-number signature enum to check
        Returns:
        true if the signature corresponds to a supported preview format, false otherwise
